newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanjing Panda in Motorola phone contract.
newsitem.headline: Nanjing Panda in Motorola phone contract.

text.p: Nanjing Panda Electronics Co Ltd said on Wednesday it has signed a contract with Motorola Inc allowing Panda to market a China-made GSM digital cellular telephone in China.
The Panda 96E is based on Motorola's most recent cellular model, the International 8400, it said. It will go on sale on September 10 at a price around 10 percent below that of the Motorola model.
It said China had approved, for the first time, open sales of 50,000 Panda 96E phones.
Panda did not reveal any the financial arrangements of its deal with Motorola.
It said Panda and Motorola would study the possibility of establishing a joint venture plant to manufacture cellular phones.
Panda and Motorola already have cooperative ventures in pagers and power PCs.
